svg.title: THE DEVELOPMENT - week 3: front and back on one page (127 x 104 mm)
svg.desc: Split off THE ZONE on purpose. The 5x5 grid on THE ZONE (and in each person board's SKILLS box) is live from week 1, but Learn/Teach and the Ledger's Capability/Capital payoff don't exist before week 3 - so this panel sits face-down beside THE ZONE until week 3, then turns over - the same week the Specimen panel on each person board starts being read. Cut both panels out, glue them to opposite faces of one piece of 2 mm greyboard. Print at 100% on one side of one sheet.
svg.text: THE DEVELOPMENT · BOTH FACES ON THIS PAGE · PRINT AT 100%
turn this up at the start of week 3

g.text: HOW YOU COVER
LEARN
pick up a new square, left or right of one you
cover, in your own row. The team names who. No teacher.
TEACH
let a partner mark a square - up, down,
left or right of one you cover, in any row.
BOTH
mark your SPECIMEN, then put down or flip a tile on THE ZONE.
One step from what you cover (Vygotsky's ZPD). A square got this week can't be taught this week.
THE LEDGER READS THIS
CAPABILITY · A FULL LINE
a whole row or column of THE ZONE tiled → +1 Capability
SHARED PRACTICE · A STACK
a tile flipped to its stacked face → +1 Shared Practice
CROSS-TRAINED · A 3RD ROW
your SPECIMEN covers a 3rd row → +1 Capital, once each
BOURDIEU 1986 · VYGOTSKY 1978 · MARX 1846

svg.text: this is the side showing while it sits beside THE ZONE

g.text: TURN ME OVER
START OF WEEK 3
The Zone has more to it than the grid.
Covering a square is only half of it - the tiles on the
Zone, and what they pay, come next.

svg.text: Cut both panels out, glue them to opposite faces of one piece of 2 mm greyboard -
Front and back on the same board. Stand it beside THE ZONE with the back showing,
and turn it over in place at the start of week 3.
